diff --git a/tests/unit/config/test_qtargs.py b/tests/unit/config/test_qtargs.py
index 1cb1494..081061f 100644
--- a/tests/unit/config/test_qtargs.py
+++ b/tests/unit/config/test_qtargs.py
@@ -129,6 +129,50 @@ class TestWebEngineArgs:
         for value in values:
             option.typ.to_py(value)  # for validation
 
+    def test_accelerated_canvas_defaults_to_auto(self, config_stub):
+        """Use version-aware canvas behavior unless explicitly configured."""
+        assert config_stub.val.qt.workarounds.disable_accelerated_2d_canvas == 'auto'
+
+    @pytest.mark.parametrize('qt_version, mode, expected', [
+        ('5.15.2', 'auto', False),
+        ('6.5.3', 'auto', True),
+        ('6.6.0', 'auto', False),
+        ('6.5.3', 'always', True),
+        ('6.6.0', 'always', True),
+        ('6.5.3', 'never', False),
+        ('6.6.0', 'never', False),
+    ])
+    def test_accelerated_canvas_workaround(self, config_stub, parser, version_patcher,
+                                           monkeypatch, qt_version, mode, expected):
+        """Apply the canvas workaround only for the selected version and mode."""
+        version_patcher(qt_version)
+        monkeypatch.setattr(qtargs.machinery, 'IS_QT6', qt_version.startswith('6.'))
+        config_stub.val.qt.workarounds.disable_accelerated_2d_canvas = mode
+
+        args = qtargs.qt_args(parser.parse_args([]))
+
+        assert ('--disable-accelerated-2d-canvas' in args) == expected
+
+    @pytest.mark.parametrize('chromium_major, expected', [
+        (None, False),
+        (0, False),
+        (110, True),
+        (111, False),
+    ])
+    def test_accelerated_canvas_auto_chromium_boundary(
+        self, config_stub, monkeypatch, parser, chromium_major, expected,
+    ):
+        """Unknown Chromium versions and version 111 omit the workaround."""
+        versions = version.WebEngineVersions.from_pyqt('6.5.3')
+        versions.chromium_major = chromium_major
+        monkeypatch.setattr(qtargs.machinery, 'IS_QT6', True)
+        config_stub.val.qt.workarounds.disable_accelerated_2d_canvas = 'auto'
+
+        args = list(qtargs._qtwebengine_settings_args(
+            versions, parser.parse_args([]), []))
+
+        assert ('--disable-accelerated-2d-canvas' in args) == expected
+
     @pytest.mark.parametrize('backend, qt_version, debug_flag, expected', [
         # QtWebEngine: Enable with -D stack, do nothing without it.
         (usertypes.Backend.QtWebEngine, '5.15.2', True, True),
